name: Playwright MCP for Browser Automation
prerequisites: npm or npx available in PATH

steps.title: Install Playwright MCP Server
steps.notes: Or use npx for on-demand execution

steps.title: Restart IDE
steps.notes: Close and reopen your IDE to load MCP configuration

steps.title: Verify Installation
steps.notes: Check MCP panel in IDE for 'playwright' server
